motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Pencil strokes, ring draw, map fades; only under no-preference reduced motion.

components.name: Evidence Cell
components.description: Pressable white cell: serif quote, mark, relation, reference tag.

narrative.overview: ProofGraph looks like an auditor's working paper: cool white ruled sheet, blue-black ink, hand-drawn pencil marks each with a legend entry and a workpaper reference. Stamp cobalt is the single saturated field and the primary action. Serif speaks for documents; grotesk speaks for ProofGraph.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled sheet ground, square corners, ink borders.
One cobalt field, on the entrance hero.
Five pencil marks plus a clash mark, each with a legend entry.

rules.name: The Four Carriers Rule
rules.body: An answer is word + pen colour + mark shape + underline style.

rules.name: The Document White Rule
rules.body: Pure white means a document or a box that holds a record.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: Cobalt fills a field only as the entrance hero.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif is for quoted document text only; all ProofGraph speech is grotesk.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Figures and page references use tabular numerals; no monospace face.

rules.name: The Paper Only Rule
rules.body: Shadow belongs to a document or sheet; controls, cells and boxes never cast one.

dos: Do give every answer all four carriers: word, pen colour, mark, underline style.
Do set quotes in Source Serif 4 on Document White.
Do tag sections and cells with a workpaper reference.
Do write gaps as open items.
Do keep controls square, at least 44px, with the 3px cobalt focus ring.
donts: Don't use a chat box, citation chips or a confidence score.
Don't use cobalt as a fill inside the product.
Don't put a shadow on cells, buttons or boxes.
Don't use a monospace face or set ProofGraph's words in the serif.
Don't use colour alone to carry an answer.
